title: What Is Crystal Garden: Idle Merge? A Calm Gem Merge Game
subtitle: A calm idle merge game for Android with 18 floating islands, 108 gems and income that keeps growing while you are away.
description: What is Crystal Garden: Idle Merge? An Android idle merge game with 18 floating islands, gems that grow into crystals, offline income, goals and 12 languages. Free, rewarded ads only.
card: The story behind Crystal Garden: Idle Merge, a calm Android merge game with 18 floating islands, offline income, daily rewards and a gem shop. Coming soon to Google Play.

faq.q: Is Crystal Garden: Idle Merge free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Crystal Garden is free to play. Ads are optional rewarded ads that you choose to watch for a bonus, and nothing pops up in your way. Gem packs and Remove Ads are optional purchases, and nothing is needed to finish the game.

faq.q: Does Crystal Garden: Idle Merge earn while the game is closed?
faq.a: Yes. Every gem earns gold by the second, and your islands keep earning offline. When you come back, a Welcome back screen shows the gold you collected, and you can watch an optional ad to double it.

faq.q: Does Crystal Garden need an account?
faq.a: No. There is no account and no sign-up. You can contact the developer from Settings with the built in support chat.

faq.q: What languages does Crystal Garden support?
faq.a: Twelve: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

faq.q: When can I play Crystal Garden: Idle Merge?
faq.a: Crystal Garden has been sent to Google Play for review and is coming soon. The game page on this site will show the store link as soon as it is live.
